3 · Proposed story order
    

    Editorial relationships
    

    Maintain a source edition
    Retain the replacement source without selecting it in the current review. Compare exact occurrences, review what to carry, then save a new editorial revision. Original source and review history remain available.
    

    

    Institution metadata changes
    

    

    Suggestions use literal title and URL. Repeated URLs remain separate records; changed or omitted reviewed entries need a reason. Carrying a rights observation preserves its original basis; it does not establish permission for new source material.
    

    

    Prepared effects
    

    4 · Save a review & deliver
    The ZIP includes every source, saved review, unfinished working copy, structured metadata, printable review and file checksums. Native export uses the existing merchant generator and its saved text mapping.
    

    Complete editable draft JSON
    Unfinished text is retained before Apply. Applying a complete document replaces only this draft; original source and saved history remain.
